description: Convert between YAML and JSON. Operations: "yaml-to-json" — Convert YAML to JSON.; "json-to-yaml" — Convert JSON to YAML.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: yaml-to-json: The YAML text to convert. json-to-yaml: The JSON text to convert.

operation.description: yaml-to-json — Convert YAML to JSON. json-to-yaml — Convert JSON to YAML.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

name: yaml-json
title: YAML / JSON Converter
